title: fix(rest, service-analytics, objectql): the dataset query door and the dataset tools resolve a dataset by package (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XQMGjkw5vnTf1d9TqeDZy9)_

Fixes #32072

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Narrowing: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of the readers epic #31527 (ADR-0150): one of the readers #31700 needs before it can narrow.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：分析查询门 `POST /analytics/dataset/query` 的 `datasetName` 和 MCP 工具 `query_dataset` 不再取列表里第一个同名 dataset，改按 ADR-0150 D3 的同一条规则按包解析；`dataset` 进 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`，`/meta/dataset` 也按包回答；查询门新增可选 `?package=`，与 `/meta` 的 `?package=` 同名同义。
- 为什么改：两个包都带同名 dataset 时（phase 1 冷启动只告警就能起来），今天谁先列出就跑谁的，跑错数据而无声；这是 #31700 收窄前缺的读取方之一。
- 风险与回滚：单持有者的 dataset 每个入口答案不变（9 个 dataset 逐字节比对 9/9 相同）；只有同名两持有者从「跑第一个」变成 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` 的 datasetName 分支，和 `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` 的 `resolveSavedDataset`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/dataset-package-scoped-readers.dogfood.test.ts`（需先 build），6 条全绿：裸名 409 列两包、`?package=` 各跑各的、MCP 工具 409、CONTROL 单持有者不变。
- 需要你做的：暂无；先过史诗席位红线评审（PASS）与席位 ACCEPT，之后再请审批人。

## What changes

- **Query door** (`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`). A `datasetName` is read through the metadata protocol's by-name read, `getMetaItem({ type: 'dataset', name, previewDrafts? })`, instead of `getMetaItems` plus `list.find`. With `dataset` in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` that read is `registry.resolveItem`'s D3: the environment's own item, else the one package holding the name, else `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, answered `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder, with nothing run.
- **`?package=PACKAGE_ID`** on the query door is the same read with `packageId`, which is G1's exact qualifier (`admitExactQualifier`), so it means exactly what `/meta/:type/:name?package=` means: that package's dataset, or `409` naming the holders. Parsed by the existing `metaItemPackageBinding` (empty or `all` names no package). A repeated `?package=` is refused `400` like a repeated `?preview=`.
- **Fail closed** (6729233545). A composed protocol with no `getMetaItem` answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` for a `datasetName`; it no longer falls back to a list read.
- **Dataset AI tools** (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts`). `query_dataset` keeps loading the list (the tools need it for `list_datasets`), but resolves the name with core `resolvePackageScopedHolders` over the listed rows' `_packageId`s, for a caller with no package (today's only producer is MCP, HTTP and stdio). A row with no `_packageId`, or `sys_metadata`, is the environment's own item. Two holders throw `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), even if one holder failed to parse. Tool input is unchanged.
- **`dataset` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`** (`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`), so the bare `/meta/dataset/NAME` with two holders answers `409`, and `/meta/dataset/NS/NAME` and `?package=` each reach their own holder.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/dataset-package-scoped-readers.dogfood.test.ts` (new, booted showcase plus two packages of two namespaces, `com.qa.bare.alpha` and `com.qa.bare.beta`, each shipping `qa_shared_dataset` over its own object): bare door `409` naming both, running nothing; `?package=` alpha and beta each run their own (`FROM "alpha_item"` / `FROM "beta_item"`, own labels); `?package=` naming a non-holder `409`; `/meta/dataset` bare `409`, qualified and `?package=` each their own; MCP `query_dataset` refused naming both; CONTROL: a single-holder dataset answers identically bare and with `?package=`, on `/meta` and through the tool. 6/6.
- `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`: new `[#32072]` describe (bare read sends no `packageId` and never lists; `?package=` forwarded; empty and `all` name no package; draft preview forwarded beside the qualifier; refusal becomes `409` naming both, nothing run; repeated `?package=` `400`).
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`: new `[#32072]` describe (two holders `409` in either list order, nothing read; refused even when one holder fails to parse; CONTROL one package holder; environment rows without `_packageId` or with `sys_metadata`; an only holder that fails to parse stays `404`).
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`: new `[#32072] dataset` describe at the protocol, registry and facade (two holders refused, `packageId` each own, non-holder qualifier refused, CONTROL one holder and environment item).

### Forced test changes (named)

- `analytics-routes.test.ts`: the CONTROL "a protocol with no getMetaItems keeps its answer, 404" now reads "a protocol with no by-name read fails closed: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, nothing run" (the fail-closed ruling, Q3); the 503 test is renamed "when the by-name read throws"; protocol doubles for `datasetName` now provide `getMetaItem` (helper `savedDatasets`).
- `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`: the list-equality pin of `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` now expects the E8 types plus `dataset`.
- Protocol doubles switched from `getMetaItems` to `getMetaItem` (same items, by name): `analytics-dataset-body-door.test.ts` (its two "list read not called" asserts now name `getMetaItem`), `analytics-16019-driver-declared-fault.test.ts`, `analytics-dataset-row-wildcard-door.test.ts`, `analytics-dataset-ai-tools-parity.test.ts`.
- `analytics-dataset-body-door.test.ts` and `analytics-16019-driver-declared-fault.test.ts` gain a module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql';`: `pnpm check:test-source-alias` judges every test file a change edits, and both reach a handler's dynamic objectql import with no module-scope load.

### Ablation (each leg restored, `git diff HEAD` empty; legs 1 and 2 ran on a rebuilt dist, rebuilt again after restore and preflighted absent; leg 3 is source-only)

- Leg 1, `dataset` out of `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (objectql rebuilt, preflight marker present): 3 dogfood pins red (bare door ran alpha's, `200`). A first attempt that renamed the literal failed the DTS build and so ran nothing; the leg that counts used a type-preserving replacement.
- Leg 2, the tools' `loaded.datasets.find` first-match restored (service-analytics rebuilt): 2 unit pins red, the MCP dogfood pin red.
- Leg 3, the door's `?package=` dropped: 2 unit pins red.

### CONTROL readings

Step 0 on `main` ff04ad81, same probe on this head: for all 9 single-holder datasets of the showcase (plugin-auth 5, showcase 4) the list item and the by-name item are identical, and the door's answer is byte-identical between base and head, 9/9.

## Verification (head 04b67d43)

- Typecheck exit 0 for `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/service-analytics`, `@objectstack/objectql`. Unit: objectql 584 files / 12030 tests, rest 404 / 7964 (355 skipped), service-analytics 214 / 5164 (332 skipped), all green.
- Dogfood, every `analytics-*`, `bare-name-one-holder*` and the new file: 17 files, 115 tests, green.
- Root eslint (`--no-inline-config`) exit 0 on each touched package.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 75 commands, each run with its exit recorded; `--ran`: 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two needed a second run: `check:test-source-alias` (fixed by the two module-top imports above) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (a shallow clone missing its pinned fixture commit; green after fetching it).

## Acceptance notes

- `build-probes.ts` reads `readItem('dataset', dsName)`; for a name two packages hold it now gets the `409` and skips probing that widget instead of probing the first holder.
- Out of scope, noted not filed: the dataset tools' input has no package spelling (a spec surface), so a model cannot name one of two same-name entries `list_datasets` shows; and dashboards, reports and charts do not carry their package to the query door yet (UI card, raised with the epic seat). The card's pins "alpha's dashboard runs alpha's dataset" and "each tool hits its own" are therefore pinned at the server half only: `?package=` on the door, refusal on the tool.
